source_text: XIV. Ἐγὼ μὲν οὖν τοῦτο τὸ ψεῦσμα, ὃ λέγουσιν ὡς νῦν γεγονός, ἐκ παιδὸς ἡλικίας ἤκουον λεγόντων Ἰουδαίων. Ἔστι δὲ γεγραμμένον ὅτι ὁ Σαοὺλ ἐπηρώτησεν ἐν τῷ ἐγγαστριμύθῳ καὶ εἶπεν τῇ γυναικὶ τῇ οὕτω μαντευομένῃ· Ἀνάγαγέ μοι τὸν Σαμουὴλ τὸν προφήτην. Καὶ εἶδεν ἡ γυνὴ ἄνδρα ὄρθιον ἀναβαίνοντα ἐν διπλοΐδι. Καὶ ἔγνω Σαοὺλ ὅτι οὗτος Σαμουήλ, καὶ ἐπηρώτησε περὶ ὧν ἐβούλετο. Τί οὖν; Ἠδύνατο ἡ ἐγγαστρίμυθος ἀναγαγεῖν τὸν Σαμουὴλ ἢ οὔ; Οἳ μὲν οὖν λέγουσιν ὅτι Ναί, ὡμολογήκασι τὴν ἀδικίαν πλέον ἰσχύειν τῆς δικαιοσύνης, καὶ ἐπικατάρατοί εἶσιν. Εἰ δὲ εἴπωσιν ὅτι οὐκ ἀνήγαγεν, ἄρα οὖν οὐδὲ τὸν Χριστὸν τὸν κύριον. Ἣ δὲ ὑπόδειξις τοῦδε τοῦ λόγου ἐστὶ τοιαύτη. Πῶς ἠδύνατο ἡ ἄδικος ἐγγαστρίμυθος, ἡ δαίμων, ἀναγαγεῖν τὴν τοῦ ἁγίου προφήτου ψυχὴν τὴν ἀναπαυομένην ἐν κόλποις Ἀβραάμ; Τὸ γὰρ ἔλαττον ὑπὸ τοῦ κρείττονος κελεύεται. Ὃ οὖν ὡς ἐκεῖνον ὑπολαμβάνουσιν ἀνηνέχθη ὁ Σαούλ; Μὴ γένοιτο· ἀλλ᾽ ἔστι τοιοῦτό τι. Ὃ παντὶ τῷ ἀποστάτῃ γενομένῳ θεοῦ οἱ τῆς ἀποστασίας παρέπονται ἄγγελοι, καὶ παντὶ φαρμακῷ καὶ μάγῳ καὶ γόητι καὶ μάντει διαβολικοὶ ὑπουργοῦσι λειτουργοί. Καὶ οὐ θαυμαστόν· φησὶ γὰρ ὁ ἀπόστολος· Αὐτὸς ὁ σατανᾶς μετασχηματίζεται εἰς ἄγγελον φωτός, οὐ μέγα οὖν εἰ καὶ οἱ διάκονοι αὐτοῦ μετασχηματίζονται ὡς διάκονοι δικαιοσύνης. Ἐπεὶ πῶς καὶ ὁ ἀντίχριστος ὡς ὁ Χριστὸς φανήσεται; Ἢ οὐχ ὅτι οὖν ἀνήγαγε τὸν Σαμουήλ, ἀλλὰ τῇ ἐγγαστριμύθῳ καὶ τῷ ἀποστάτῃ Σαοὺλ δαίμονες ταρταραῖοι ἐξομοιωθέντες τῷ Σαμουὴλ ἐνεφάνισαν ἑαυτούς. Διδάξει δὲ αὐτὴ ἡ γραφή· λέγει γὰρ δῆθεν ὁ ὀφθεὶς Σαμουὴλ τῷ Σαούλ· Καὶ σὺ σήμερον μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ ἔσῃ. Πῶς δύναται ὁ εἰδωλολάτρης Σαοὺλ εὑρεθῆναι μετὰ Σαμουήλ; Ἢ δῆλον ὅτι μετὰ τῶν ἀνόμων καὶ τῶν ἀπατησάντων αὐτὸν καὶ κυριευσάντων αὐτοῦ δαιμόνων. Ἄρα οὖν οὐκ ἦν Σαμουήλ. Εἰ δὲ ἀδύνατόν ἐστι τὴν τοῦ ἁγίου προφήτου ἀναγαγεῖν ψυχήν, πῶς τὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, ὃν ἀναλαμβανόμενον εἶδον οἱ μαθηταὶ καὶ ὑπὲρ τοῦ μὴ ἀρνήσασθαι αὐτὸν ἀπέθανον, οἷόν τέ ἐστιν ἐκ γῆς ἀνερχόμενον ὀφθῆναι; Ἃ δὲ ταῦτα μὴ δύνασθε ἀντιτιθέναι αὑτοῖς, λέγων πρὸς αὐτούς· Ὅπως ἂν ἡμεῖς ὑμῶν τῶν χωρὶς ἀνάγκης ἐκπορνευσάντων καὶ εἰδωλολατρησάντων κρείττονές ἐσμεν. Καὶ μὴ συγκατάθεσθε αὐτοῖς ἐν ἀπογνώσει γενόμενοι, ἀδελφοί, ἀλλὰ τῇ μετανοίᾳ προσμείνατε τῷ Χριστῷ· ἐλεήμων γάρ ἐστι δέξασθαι πάλιν ὑμᾶς ὡς τέκνα.
pass_a_gloss: I have heard this false tale, said to have just occurred, from Jews telling it since I was a child. Scripture says Saul consulted a belly-voice diviner and told the divining woman to bring up Samuel the prophet, she saw an upright man ascending in a cloak, Saul took him for Samuel and questioned him. Could she raise Samuel or not? Saying yes confesses injustice stronger than justice and brings a curse; saying no denies she raised Christ the Lord either. Proof: how could an unjust divining demon raise the holy prophet's soul resting in Abraham's lap, since the lesser is ruled by the greater. What Saul thought was raised was not that man, God forbid, but this: apostasy-angels accompany every apostate from God, and devilish ministers serve every drug-mixer, magician, charmer and seer. No wonder, for Satan refashions himself as light's angel and his servants as justice's servants, as Antichrist will show as Christ. Tartarean demons imitating Samuel showed themselves to the woman and apostate Saul, not Samuel. Scripture shows it when the seeming Samuel says you shall be with me today, which idolatrous Saul cannot be with Samuel but with lawless deceiving demons mastering him, so it was not Samuel. If a holy prophet's soul cannot be raised, how can Jesus in heaven, seen taken up and confessed unto death by disciples, be seen ascending from earth. If you cannot pit these things against them, tell them we are better than you who whored and idolized without necessity. Do not assent to them in despair, brothers, but abide by repentance with Christ, for he is merciful to take you back as children.
pass_b_english: I for my part have heard this lying fabrication, which they say has just now happened, from Jews repeating it ever since I was of a child's age.

For it stands written that Saul inquired through a ventriloquist-medium and said to the woman who practices divination in this way, Bring up for me Samuel the prophet (1 Samuel 28:8-11), and the woman saw an upright man coming up clothed in a double mantle, and Saul concluded that this was Samuel and asked him about what he wanted (1 Samuel 28:13-14).
What then?
Was the medium able to bring Samuel up, or not?
Those who say Yes have admitted that unrighteousness is stronger than righteousness, and they stand accursed.
But if they say she did not bring him up, then neither did she bring up Christ the Lord.
The exposure of this argument runs thus: how could the unrighteous medium, herself a demon, bring up the soul of the holy prophet resting in the bosom of Abraham (Luke 16:22)?
For the lesser is commanded by the greater.
What then was it that Saul supposed had been brought up in that man's guise?

May it never be so, but the matter is something like this: angels of apostasy attach themselves to everyone who has become an apostate from God, and devilish attendants serve every sorcerer and magician and charmer and diviner.

And this is no marvel, for the apostle says, Satan himself refashions himself into an angel of light, so it is no great thing if his servants also refashion themselves as servants of righteousness (2 Corinthians 11:14-15).
For how else will the Antichrist also appear as the Christ?
So she did not bring up Samuel; rather Tartarean demons, having made themselves like Samuel, manifested themselves to the medium and to apostate Saul.
Scripture itself will teach this, for the supposed Samuel who was seen says to Saul, And you today shall be with me (1 Samuel 28:19).
How can the idolater Saul be found with Samuel?
It is plain that he shall be with the lawless and with the demons that deceived him and mastered him.
Therefore it was not Samuel.

And if it is impossible to bring up the soul of the holy prophet, how is it possible for Jesus Christ in the heavens, whom the disciples saw being taken up and for refusal to deny whom they died, to be seen coming up out of the earth?
If you are unable to set these answers against them on your own, say to them, In this we are better than you who committed fornication and idolatry though under no compulsion.
And do not, out of despair, give your assent to them, brothers, but by repentance abide with Christ, for he is merciful to receive you again as children.

lemmas.gloss: bosom, lap of Abraham as rest

choices.why: Feminine noun in context governs divining woman and is glossed as a demon; renders belly-voice divination rather than generic witchcraft.
Neuter noun for a contrived false event claimed as now happened, not mere error; keeps accusatory force.
Genitive shows refutation of opponents' claim, not neutral demonstration; fits polemical context.
